classification.difficultyReason: 1E Q17: Linked familiar operations with signs, exact values or endpoint/domain checks. The positive denominator 3 preserves both strict signs; use two open endpoints.

content.prompt: Solve the inequality and represent the solution on a number line. $$-2<\frac{x+1}{3}<3.$$

answer.worked:
Multiply all three expressions by $3$, then subtract $1$.

$$\begin{align*}-6&<x+1<9\\-7&<x<8\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Solution segment with open endpoints −7 and 8. The solution set is separated above the thin reference axis, with endpoint-aligned axis ticks; semantic endpoint masks and fills retained.
